note: Otsego County (MI) publishes its county zoning map (covering county and City of Gaylord districts) only as a PDF. Its ArcGIS-based GIS portal (otsegocountygis.mapxpress.net) is a sign-in viewer with no public zoning FeatureServer found; FetchGIS is a commercial viewer without a queryable zoning service. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online and the Gaylord city site found no zoning polygon layer.
